reviews.review:
This game on release was a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, now Redfall is slightly better but still ultimately a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.
It's a shame that due to Arkane Austin closing down, we'll never see what the "real vision behind Redfall" was,
if there was one.

I just gotta say, man damn - I love bows, and apparently they were gonna release a dude or a gal, idc with a bow next or something.
Really, you had to close the studio just before that? I suffered through 50+ hours of mediocre videogaming and don't even get to enjoy the bow?? helloooooo.

Oh well, life's not fair.

Oh yeah the game, the game sucks.
